svg.data-port-modes-osfp224: 64 x 1.6TbE; 50/100/200/400/800GbE with breakouts; 128 x 800GbE, 256 x 400GbE, 512 x 200GbE
svg.data-psus: 2+2 redundant hot-swap 3200 W, AC or DC
svg.data-fans: 4+1 field-replaceable fan modules, dual-rotor, 9+1 rotor redundancy
svg.data-bmc: RunBMC, 2 GB DDR4, dual 128 MB flash for dual boot, OpenBMC, serial over LAN
svg.data-software: SONiC; ONIE for compatible open-source and commercial NOS
svg.data-optics-osfp: Up to 32 W / 40 W transceivers, up to 1 m DAC (datasheet OPTICS / Cables; not split by port type)
svg.data-timing: IEEE 1588 1-step and 2-step time stamping; transparent and boundary clock; SyncE clock recovery; 1PPS, 10 MHz and ToD interfaces
svg.data-mgmt-ports: 2 x 50GbE SFP56 management, RJ45 console (CON0, CON1), RJ45 GbE OOB, USB 3.0 Type-A, USB-C console
svg.data-emissions: AS/NZS CISPR32:2015+A1:2020 Class A; ICES-003 Issue 7:2020 Class A; EN55032:2015/AC:2016 Class A; VCCI-CISPR 32:2016 Class A; TEC/SD/DD/EMC-221/05/OCT-16 Class A; FCC CFR 47 Part 15 Subpart B Class A; EN/IEC61000-3-2; EN/IEC61000-3-3
